rationale:
runtimes/csharp/main.cs: Only v2 Entity.entity_id changes from string to bytes. For observations, the decoded ByteString must be UTF-8 decoded to string (ByteString.ToStringUtf8()) to preserve the entity_id observation key with string value. For construction, the string literal must be UTF-8 encoded to ByteString (ByteString.CopyFromUtf8()). v1 paths remain unchanged since v1 schema still uses string. The standalone sample identifier "cs_202" is preserved in both versions. All three subscribers independently decode both schema versions via ProcessEntity.
runtimes/python/main.py: v2 schema changed entity_id from string to bytes. For observations, the output key entity_id must remain a string, so decode v2 bytes as UTF-8. When constructing a v2 Entity in the standalone sample, encode the identifier as UTF-8 bytes. v1 behavior is untouched. Version selection is explicit in both code paths.
runtimes/typescript/main.ts: Changed v2 entity_id from string to bytes per schema. For observations (C001), decode v2 bytes to UTF-8 string to keep output key entity_id as string; v1 unchanged. For sample construction (C003), encode the standalone identifier "ts_303" as UTF-8 bytes for v2 encode(); v1 sample (C002) remains string. All three subscribers independently decode both versions. No changes to tests, bindings, or v1 relay behavior.
assumptions: runtimes/csharp/main.cs: Generated C# bindings for v2 Entity.EntityId now return Google.Protobuf.ByteString
runtimes/csharp/main.cs: ByteString.ToStringUtf8() performs UTF-8 decoding matching the intended behavior
runtimes/csharp/main.cs: ByteString.CopyFromUtf8(string) performs UTF-8 encoding matching the intended behavior
runtimes/csharp/main.cs: The observation contract requires entity_id key with string value (not base64 or raw bytes)
runtimes/csharp/main.cs: No changes to v1 schema or generated bindings
runtimes/csharp/main.cs: Pub/sub delivery payload remains base64-encoded protobuf bytes as before
runtimes/python/main.py: Generated Python bindings for v2 expose entity_id as bytes; .decode('utf-8') yields the correct string observation.
runtimes/python/main.py: The sample identifier "py_101" is valid ASCII/UTF-8 and round-trips identically.
runtimes/python/main.py: No other code in this file reads or writes entity_id for v2.
runtimes/typescript/main.ts: Generated TS bindings for v2 Entity.entity_id expose Uint8Array (bytes) for both decode output and encode input.
runtimes/typescript/main.ts: TextEncoder/TextDecoder are available in the Node.js runtime (global).
runtimes/typescript/main.ts: The sample identifier "ts_303" is valid UTF-8 and round-trips identically.
runtimes/typescript/main.ts: Arbitrary non-UTF-8 bytes and mixed-version interoperability are out of scope.
runtimes/typescript/main.ts: Observation key 'entity_id' must be a string in JSON output for both versions.
